responsibility: This module is the GNU Modula-2 standard library and runtime support collection that sits beneath generated gm2 programs, providing the language’s core execution environment, system interfaces, and reusable base facilities. Its files divide broadly into low-level compiler/runtime boundary modules such as SYSTEM, Builtins, libc/libm/cbuiltin/wrapc bindings, storage and memory helpers, and startup/dependency/exception machinery in M2RTS, M2Dependent, M2EXCEPTION, RTExceptions, and SysExceptions; general-purpose library services such as DynamicStrings, StringConvert, FormatStrings, numeric I/O and math families, command-line and environment access, and filesystem wrappers in both ARRAY OF CHAR and DynamicStrings forms; and user-visible I/O, scanning, debugging, terminal, event, and coroutine-related support built around FIO, IO, StdIO, StrIO, PushBackInput, Scan, RTint, and Selective. Taken together, gcc/m2/gm2-libs implements the stable Modula-2 runtime and library substrate, including host adaptation and configuration support, that distinguishes gm2 language support from GCC’s generic middle end or target back ends.
